blocks.title: Let's Sing!
blocks.body: Are you ready to sing Jack and Jill? It is one of the most fun songs!

blocks.title: Jack and Jill
blocks.content:
Jack and Jill went up the hill
To fetch a pail of water.

blocks.title: For Parents & Teachers
blocks.content: Encourage the child to do the hand actions while singing this rhyme to build motor skills.
